context: Tests whether the agent distinguishes rolling-stable (distroless, Chainguard, vendor-:latest) from rolling-dev (alpine:edge, debian:sid, ubuntu:devel) — never conflating them — and whether Ubuntu interim releases land in non-lts-interim rather than one-behind LTS.

checklist.name: alpine:edge → rolling-dev
checklist.description: alpine:edge classified as status: rolling-dev (NOT rolling-stable, NOT one-behind, NOT current). os_family: alpine.

checklist.name: debian:sid → rolling-dev
checklist.description: debian:sid classified as status: rolling-dev. os_family: debian.

checklist.name: distroless → rolling-stable
checklist.description: gcr.io/distroless/static-debian13:nonroot classified as status: rolling-stable. os_family: distroless.

checklist.name: Chainguard :latest → rolling-stable
checklist.description: cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest classified as status: rolling-stable (NOT rolling-dev). The :latest tag of a vendor-managed minimal base is rolling-stable.

checklist.name: ubuntu:25.10 → non-lts-interim
checklist.description: ubuntu:25.10 classified as os_family: ubuntu-interim and status: non-lts-interim (NOT one-behind LTS, NOT current LTS).

checklist.name: ubuntu:22.04 → one-behind LTS
checklist.description: ubuntu:22.04 classified as os_family: ubuntu-lts and status: one-behind (jammy is previous LTS; noble is current).

checklist.name: ubuntu:24.04 → current LTS
checklist.description: ubuntu:24.04 classified as os_family: ubuntu-lts and status: current.

checklist.name: debian:bookworm → one-behind
checklist.description: debian:bookworm-slim classified as os_family: debian, os_version: 12, status: one-behind.

checklist.name: debian:trixie → current
checklist.description: debian:trixie-slim classified as os_family: debian, os_version: 13, status: current.

checklist.name: alpine:3.22 → one-behind
checklist.description: alpine:3.22 classified as os_family: alpine, os_version: 3.22, status: one-behind.

checklist.name: scratch → none / null
checklist.description: FROM scratch classified as os_family: none (or null) with no os_version. Status may be null or n/a.

checklist.name: No 'rolling' catch-all bucket
checklist.description: The output does NOT use a generic 'rolling' status value (without -dev or -stable suffix). The two classes are kept distinct everywhere.
